schema.title: Dependency Graph Diff
schema.description: A diff of the dependencies between two commits.

scope.description: Where the dependency is utilized. `development` means that the dependency is only utilized in the development environment. `runtime` means that the dependency is utilized at runtime and in the development environment.

403.description: Response for a private repository when GitHub Advanced Security is not enabled, or if used against a fork

schema.title: Dependency Graph SPDX SBOM
schema.description: A schema for the SPDX JSON format returned by the Dependency Graph.

SPDXID.description: The SPDX identifier for the SPDX document.

spdxVersion.description: The version of the SPDX specification that this document conforms to.

comment.example: Exact versions could not be resolved for some packages. For more information: https://docs.github.com/en/code-security/supply-chain-security/understanding-your-software-supply-chain/
comment.description: An optional comment about the SPDX document.

created.description: The date and time the SPDX document was created.

creators.description: The tools that were used to generate the SPDX document.

name.description: The name of the SPDX document.

dataLicense.description: The license under which the SPDX document is licensed.

documentNamespace.description: The namespace for the SPDX document.

SPDXID.description: A unique SPDX identifier for the package.

versionInfo.description:
The version of the package. If the package does not have an exact version specified,
a version range is given.

downloadLocation.description:
The location where the package can be downloaded,
or NOASSERTION if this has not been determined.

filesAnalyzed.description:
Whether the package's file content has been subjected to
analysis during the creation of the SPDX document.

licenseConcluded.description: The license of the package as determined while creating the SPDX document.

licenseDeclared.description:
The license of the package as declared by its author, or NOASSERTION if this information
was not available when the SPDX document was created.

supplier.description: The distribution source of this package, or NOASSERTION if this was not determined.

copyrightText.description: The copyright holders of the package, and any dates present with those notices, if available.

referenceCategory.description: The category of reference to an external resource this reference refers to.

referenceLocator.description: A locator for the particular external resource this reference refers to.

referenceType.description: The category of reference to an external resource this reference refers to.

relationshipType.description: The type of relationship between the two SPDX elements.

spdxElementId.description: The SPDX identifier of the package that is the source of the relationship.

relatedSpdxElement.description: The SPDX identifier of the package that is the target of the relationship.

created_at.description: The time at which the snapshot was created.

result.description: Either "SUCCESS", "ACCEPTED", or "INVALID". "SUCCESS" indicates that the snapshot was successfully created and the repository's dependencies were updated. "ACCEPTED" indicates that the snapshot was successfully created, but the repository's dependencies were not updated. "INVALID" indicates that the snapshot was malformed.

message.description: A message providing further details about the result, such as why the dependencies were not updated.

value.message: Dependency results for the repo have been successfully updated.
